name: eboekhouden-extension
description: Unofficial Chrome extension for e-Boekhouden.nl: working 1Password autofill, a session switcher and an in-page re-login dialog.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/popup/*.js src/features/*.js src/bg/*.js src/offscreen/*.js src/options/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
